Etymology tree
Old Persian 𐎣𐎫𐎱𐎬𐎢𐎣 (k-t-p-tu-u-k /⁠katpatuka⁠/)
Ancient Greek Καππαδοκία (Kappadokía)der.
Arabic قبادوقية
Derived from Ancient Greek Καππαδοκία (Kappadokía), from Old Persian 𐎣𐎫𐎱𐎬𐎢𐎣 (k-t-p-tu-u-k /⁠katpatuka⁠/).
g: Cappadocia (a historical region and ancient kingdom in central Asia Minor, in present-day Turkey)
Cappadocia (a former province of the Roman Empire, existing from 18 AD until the 7th century)
